description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the sample count across four textual categories for two distinct datasets. The unlabeled horizontal axis contains the categories, ordered from left to right as Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository. The vertical value axis is labeled "Sample Count" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 120, with numeric tick labels spaced at regular intervals of 20. The data is visually arranged into grouped bars for each category, pairing a light blue bar on the left representing the "Open" set with a light pink bar on the right representing the "Cons." set, as defined by the top-center legend. The bars do not follow a strict alphabetical, ascending, or descending sorting order across the chart, but every bar is visually emphasized with an exact bold numeric annotation indicating its value directly above it. In the Argumentative category, the Open bar is 79 and the Cons. bar is 122. For the Narrative category, the Open value is 80 and the Cons. value is 87. In the Descriptive category, the Open set has a count of 68 and the Cons. set has a count of 100. Finally, the Expository category contains both the shortest bar in the chart, representing the Open set at 62, and the tallest bar in the chart, representing the Cons. set at 130.
